Based on the `mcp-server/` subproject (the `kb-mcp` executable, server name `kb_proto_1`), here's the full MCP surface. The authoritative inventory lives in `mcp-server/src/kb/mcp_server/tools/_schemas.py:199` and `app.py`.

## 7 Tools

| Tool | What it does | Orchestrator endpoint |
|---|---|---|
| **`kb_search`** | Hybrid retrieval — returns raw grounding (chunks + files + relevance scores + previews) for the agent to synthesize over, no second LLM. Supports the bi-temporal window (`valid_period_lower/upper`, `as_of_transaction_time`). | `POST /api/v1/search` |
| **`kb_files_list`** | List source files, paginated; optional `as_of` transaction-time snapshot. | `GET /api/v1/knowledgebase/files` |
| **`kb_files_show`** | Show one source file's metadata by UUID. | `GET /api/v1/knowledgebase/files/{id}` |
| **`kb_history_show`** | Version history of a file by name, optionally as-of a past transaction time. | `GET .../history/{file_name}?as_of=` |
| **`kb_reinstate`** | Re-ingest a prior version of a file by UUID to make it current again (period-close semantics; original retained). | shared reinstate-composition helper |
| **`kb_ingest_text`** | Ingest a markdown or plain-text document (1 MB cap; `text/markdown` or `text/plain` only — other 21 MIMEs reserved for a future `kb_ingest_file`). | the widened `IngestRequest` |
| **`kb_provenance_show`** | Show the KB's embedding provenance lock (provider, model, dim) recorded at first ingest. | `GET /api/v1/system/health` |

## 3 Resource templates (`kb://` URIs)

- `kb://files/{uuid}` — a source file by UUID
- `kb://chunks/{uuid}` — a document chunk by UUID (the full chunk text; `kb_search` previews are truncated, so the search tool's own description tells agents to read the full chunk here before grounding)
- `kb://history/{file_name}{?as_of}` — version history by name, optional `as_of` snapshot

## 3 Prompts (slash-prompts)

- `/kb-search <query>` — search and ground the answer
- `/kb-ingest-this` — ingest the current document
- `/kb-remember <note>` — **reserved/disabled**; advertised with `disabled: true` and returns an `unavailable` envelope when invoked

**Note:** these are not `kb` *CLI* commands — they're the MCP tool/resource/prompt surface the `kb-mcp` server advertises to an agent host. (The CLI's own MCP management verbs — `kb mcp install/uninstall/start/stop/status` — live separately under `cli/src/kb/cli/verbs/mcp/`.) Per the `project_m2b_mcp_server_milestone` memory, this is the M2.B "7 tools / 3 resources / 3 prompts" surface; Phases 2+3 are slated post-M5.
